title: 260425_112139_FR_Steam_train_arriving_at_Noyelles by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Steam train arriving at Noyelles station. I made this recording during ‘’La fête de la vapeur’’ (The Steam Festival), held in La Baie de Somme (north of France), at the end of April 2026. Here, one can hear the atmosphere in Noyelles train station, while one of the steam trains exhibited and used during the festival was arriving. First, one can hear the stationmaster’s whistle, then the train whistling and arriving slowly, as well as the people’s reaction. At the end of the file, as the train has stopped, people start to walk on the platform to go into the cars. Recorded in April 2026 with a Z
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -24.80 dBFS); 30 ms fades
